selected_candidate: corrected Stage 8.1 37-feature pipeline (2025 feature semantics corrected for terrain + u700/v700)
note: This document records paths/hashes/configuration as they existed at freeze time. No model, feature, training procedure, or production EMS/optimizer code was modified to produce this freeze.

1_raw_sites_data.source: SITES (data.fieldsites.se), Nuolja Middle Station, 10-min resolution, 52560 rows

2_hourly_preprocessing.method: LOCKED 2024 convention: group raw 10-min rows HH:00..HH:50 -> hourly label HH:00, arithmetic mean (NaN-skip); PRECIP summed.

3_clearsky.method: pvlib Location.get_clearsky(model='ineichen'), same lat/lon/tz as 2024 (68.362074N, 18.738752E, Etc/GMT-1)

4_nwp.method: metno_seamless day-ahead previous_day1 variables via Open-Meteo previous-runs API; audit_clean method (0% synthetic imputation) -- 365/365 origins PASS (vs 347/365 in 2024, 2025 benefits from fuller archive backfill)

6_stage4_ensemble.train_test_split: 182 EVEN / 182 ODD (positional, i%2 on sorted origins)
6_stage4_ensemble.algorithm: horizon-adaptive cloud-damped clearsky ensemble: w*chronos + (1-w)*physics(clearsky_ghi, cloud_frac, k), per-horizon Nelder-Mead fit on EVEN train only

7_corrected_terrain.method: single aligned pvlib solar-position call -> round(azimuth)%360 lookup into the static DEM-derived 360-point horizon profile (reused unmodified)

correction_vs_historical_2024.defect: historical artifact's solar_azimuth column shifted -1 row vs its own TIMESTAMP
correction_vs_historical_2024.quantified_impact: 99.8% of hours shifted (mean 2.69 deg, max 10.27 deg); 234 daytime hours with flipped terrain_solar_obstruction_flag, mean ~167 W/m2 swing in clearsky_ghi_terrain_adjusted when flipped

8_corrected_u700_v700.source: MET Norway meps25epsarchive (meps_det_pl), day-ahead D-1 18Z run, via thredds.met.no OPeNDAP ASCII
8_corrected_u700_v700.coverage: horizon_hour 1-19 = genuine hourly (lead+6h..+24h from the 18Z run); horizon_hour 20-24 = documented NaN gap (archive is 3-hourly beyond lead+24h -- structural property, not fabricated)

correction_vs_historical_2024.defect: off-by-one horizon_hour: historical horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+1h vs the rest of the pipeline's +0h convention
correction_vs_historical_2024.fix: time slice shifted from [7:1:30] to [6:1:24] so horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+0h

correction_vs_historical_2024.defect: hourly/3-hourly resolution cliff: historical script silently relabeled 3-hourly archive values (lead+27h..+42h) as sequential hourly horizon_hour 19-24
correction_vs_historical_2024.fix: horizon_hour 20-24 reported as honest NaN; model retrained WITH this real missing-value pattern (native HistGradientBoostingRegressor support)

9_lwp_iwp.method: surface-aware trapezoidal vertical integration over 13 pressure levels, same-day 00Z MEPS run, unchanged formula from the historical 2024 script
9_lwp_iwp.audit_finding: historical artifact's 'valid_time' STRING column was mislabeled +1h, but the actual lwp_latest/iwp_latest VALUES used by the model merge were already correctly aligned (confirmed via live re-extraction, diff ~1e-7, floating-point noise only). CONCLUSION: no correction was needed for the feature values themselves; the 2024 file is reused unchanged on the 2024 side.

10_causal_context_features.note: Computed inline (not a separate saved file) inside build_corrected_feature_matrix.py, 14 features (ctx_std_3h/6h/12h/24h, ctx_abs_change_1h/3h/6h, ctx_max_diff_6h, ctx_mean_diff_6h, ctx_slope_6h, ctx_kt_std_6h, ctx_last_obs, ctx_mean_24h, ctx_max_24h), from the 24h window strictly BEFORE each origin, using the hourly SITES SW_IN series and clear-sky kt. Formula unchanged from the historical 2024 pipeline; verified source-column-compatible for 2025 (SW_IN column name match).

12_corrected_stage8_1_hgb_model.trained_on: 2024 EVEN origins only (174 origins, daytime rows, n=2885)

13_24h_forecast_2025_blind.generated_by: single vectorized model.predict() call over the full corrected 2025 feature matrix -- no retraining
13_24h_forecast_2025_blind.day_night_gate: causal (solar_elevation<=0 OR clearsky_ghi==0); does not read actual_SW_IN for any decision

feature_contract.target: actual_SW_IN - pred_stage4_fold (residual-on-Stage4), fit on daytime rows only
feature_contract.night_handling: prediction forced to 0.0 when is_night_causal (solar_elevation<=0 OR clearsky_ghi==0); model not applied to these rows at all

model_configuration.wrapper_for_candidate: none (single multi-row regressor on residual target, unlike Branch01's MultiOutputRegressor)
model_configuration.missing_value_handling: native (sklearn HGBT); trained WITH the real u700/v700 NaN pattern present in both EVEN-train and ODD-eval, unlike the historical model which never saw real NaN for this feature

metrics_2024_corrected_odd.note: historical (buggy-terrain/wind) 2024 ODD candidate MAE=36.1887/nMAE=28.07% shown in prior steps for context ONLY -- not a valid baseline, uses uncorrected inputs

known_limitations.description: 2025 coverage is 8736/8760 hours; 2025-01-01 (24 hours) is excluded from the entire Stage 3b-and-later chain because Chronos-2's 24h context window would require 2024-12-31 data, which is out of scope for this 2025-only rebuild. This is NOT introduced by any correction step -- it is a structural property of building 2025 in isolation from 2024.

Branch01's sw_in_lag_0h feature is the actual SW_IN observed AT the forecast origin (known at forecast time, not future data). Under this repo's horizon_hour=1 == forecast_start+0h convention, that is numerically the same timestamp as the h=1 target. This is architectural to Branch01 (a nowcast-anchored persistence feature), not a leak, but means Branch01's H1 metric is not a pure blind-ahead test in the same sense H2-H24 are. Flagged for any future comparison; no correction applied since Branch01 is frozen and not in scope to modify.

horizon_hour 20-24 (~21% of wind-feature rows, both 2024-corrected and 2025) are genuine NaN -- the MEPS pressure-level archive is hourly only through lead+24h, then 3-hourly. The corrected model was trained with this real missing-value pattern (not previously the case historically) and uses sklearn's native missing-value handling.

The historical 2024 training procedure gated night-forcing using is_daytime (actual_SW_IN>0), which technically consults the target for row selection (not as a model feature). For the 2025 blind run, this was switched to a purely causal gate (is_night_causal: solar_elevation<=0 OR clearsky_ghi==0) so that no target information is used anywhere in the blind inference path. The two gates disagree on 1,532/8,736 2025 rows (17.5%), all twilight-glow hours with small positive actual values (median 0.40 W/m2, max 43.6 W/m2); both variants were computed and reported for transparency.
affected_stages: 2025 blind evaluation only; 2024 training procedure is unchanged from historical

known_limitations.description: The historical 2024 LWP/IWP artifact's 'valid_time' display column is mislabeled +1h, but the actual lwp_latest/iwp_latest feature VALUES used by the model merge are correctly aligned (verified by live re-extraction, diff ~1e-7). No correction was needed or applied to the feature values; noted here only so this cosmetic discrepancy is not mistaken for an uncorrected bug.

historical_artifact_preservation.verification_performed_at_freeze_time: all hashes/mtimes re-confirmed identical to when first measured in this investigation
